mil7.8.1:1.1: ‘‘Bhante nāgasena, ‘kumbhassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’nti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’’nti?
mil7.8.1:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena āgame adhigame pariyattiyaṃ sāmaññe pāramiṃ patvā na saṇitabbaṃ, na tena māno karaṇīyo, na dabbo dassetabbo, nihatamānena nihatadabbena bhavitabbaṃ, ujukena amukharena avikatthinā.
mil7.8.1:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, kumbhassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
